title: FACTUM: Mechanistic Detection of Citation Hallucination in Long-Form RAG
authors: Maxime Dassen; Rebecca Kotula; Kenton Murray; Andrew Yates; Dawn Lawrie; Efsun Kayi; James Mayfield; Kevin Duh
